Test a newly added "conversation history" feature in a locally running web app (FanBox) at http://localhost:4567.

Background: The app has a chat panel. We added a history button (🕘 clock icon) next to the "＋" (new chat) button in the chat panel header. Goal: verify that starting a new conversation now archives the old one into a history list (localStorage), and that you can restore an archived conversation.

Steps:
1. Navigate to http://localhost:4567 and lock the browser tab. Do a hard reload (the static files were just edited; ensure fresh app.js/style.css/index.html load).
2. Open the chat panel. In the left side there should be a button to toggle terminal/chat (look for a "对话" tab or a terminal/chat toggle button on the left sidebar; the chat panel section has id "chat-panel"). Take a snapshot to find it. Click to open chat. Confirm you see a "对话" header with buttons including 🕘, ＋, ⚙, ✕.
3. The most reliable way to create conversation content without depending on the LLM backend: open the browser console and run this JS to simulate a conversation and exercise our functions directly:
   - `chat.addBubble('user','测试对话甲 你好'); chat.addBubble('assistant','这是甲的回答'); chat._persistCurrent(); JSON.stringify(chat._loadStore().map(s=>({title:s.title,backend:s.backend})))`
   Report the returned value. We EXPECT one entry with title starting "测试对话甲".
   If you cannot evaluate arbitrary JS in the console via the tools, instead do it through the UI: type "测试对话甲 你好" into the chat input (#chat-input) and press the 发送 (send) button; wait up to 20s to see if a reply streams in (the Cursor backend may or may not be logged in). Whether or not a reply arrives, proceed.
4. Click the ＋ (new chat) button. The message area should clear to the empty state.
5. Click the 🕘 (history) button. A popup (#chat-history-pop) should appear listing the previous conversation with its title and a meta line like "Cursor · 刚刚". Take a screenshot. EXPECT at least one history item to appear (NOT the "还没有历史对话" empty text).
6. Click the history item (not the ✕). The previous conversation's messages should be restored into the message area. Take a screenshot confirming the messages reappear.
7. Open 🕘 again, hover an item, and click the ✕ delete button on it. Confirm the item disappears from the list.

Report concisely: for each numbered step, PASS/FAIL with the key evidence (console return value or what you saw). Include 2-3 screenshots (history popup showing the archived conversation, and the restored messages). If anything failed, describe exactly what happened. Unlock the browser when done.
</user_query>
